ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels on outer lobes to low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central region and trailing edge mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields on distal lobes; dense black mottling and stippling across the lower-inner margins of both lobes; solid black pigmentation centered at the peduncle junction and extending through the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression with a narrow aperture; estimated pixel-depth approximately 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge; distinct jagged peaks at the distal tips; visible irregular 'teeth' along the mid-lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature from the distal tips tapering toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several high-contrast white circular pixel clusters located in the central dark pigmentation zone near the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark diagonal linear markings (rake marks) on the white background of the right lobe; one horizontal mark on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular tissue loss/indentations on the distal edge of the left lobe tip.
